../aboutme/index.html.title: About Me
../aboutme/index.html.description: A Versatile Roblox developer with 6+ years of experience. Skills including GFX, Building, Animation, Video Editing, 3D Modelling, and Scripting.
p: Hi! I’m a versatile Roblox developer with over six years of experience creating, designing, and contributing to immersive digital projects. My creative journey actually began in 2017 , when I started exploring video editing at a young age. What began as simple editing experiments quickly grew into a passion for digital creation.

In 2019 , when I was 9 years old, I entered the world of Roblox development. From there, my skills expanded rapidly—first into animation, then GFX design, building, and photo editing. Over time, I discovered how much I enjoy blending creativity with technical problem-solving, and I’m now actively learning scripting to bring complete game ideas to life.
English is my first language, and I love collaborating, learning from others, and constantly challenging myself to improve.
My Growth & Milestones
I’m proud of the progress I’ve made throughout the years:
2020: Reached 10,000+ contributed visits , 720 favorites , and 2,000+ social media views .
2023: Grew to 326,000+ contributed visits and 34,000+ social media views .
2025: Now at 531,000+ contributed visits and over 70,000+ social platform views .
These milestones highlight my dedication and my commitment to creating quality experiences that players enjoy.
Collaboration Experience

I’ve worked with 19 different studios , both solo and as part of a team. Each project has helped me refine my skills, learn new techniques, and understand what makes a development environment successful.

p: Welcome to my Commission Terms of Service. By commissioning me, contacting me, or receiving any work from me, you agree to
Avoid rushing or spamming messages; frequent reminders can slow progress.

Robux is no longer accepted for commissions valued above $30 USD. Any commission over that amount must be paid in USD or with a gift card .
Commissions over 15,000 Robux require a partial upfront payment before work begins.
No “pay later” or free commissions; payment must be made before final delivery.
Once the final product is delivered, no refunds will be issued.
Small revisions (text, colors, minor fixes) are free within reason.
Major changes or redesigns may require additional payment.
After the final version is approved and delivered, no further edits will be made.
Timelines vary based on project size and current workload; projects may take hours, days, or months.
Any delays due to personal or technical issues will be communicated promptly.
Clients must remain available during the commission period; lack of response may delay the project.
Full rights to the commissioned work transfer once it is fully paid.
Work may be used for personal or in-game purposes unless otherwise agreed.
You may not claim the work as your own or resell/distribute it without permission.
I reserve the right to decline commissions with inappropriate, stolen, or exploitative content.
Not all commissions may be displayed in my portfolio or on social media; showcasing is at my discretion.
Any private information shared during the commission (files, scripts, concepts, ideas, etc.) will remain confidential unless permission is given to share.
